commerceGuidelines.title: Islamic Commerce Guidelines
commerceGuidelines.description: Essential principles from the Quran and Hadith to ensure halal and ethical business practices

honesty.title: 1. Honesty and Transparency
honesty.quranArabic: يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا لَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ إِلَّا أَن تَكُونَ تِجَارَةً عَن تَرَاضٍ مِّنكُمْ
honesty.quranTranslation: O you who have believed, do not consume one another's wealth unjustly but only [in lawful] business by mutual consent.
honesty.hadithArabic: الْبَيِّعَانِ بِالْخِيَارِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقَا، فَإِنْ صَدَقَا وَبَيَّنَا بُورِكَ لَهُمَا فِي بَيْعِهِمَا، وَإِنْ كَذَبَا وَكَتَمَا مُحِقَتْ بَرَكَةُ بَيْعِهِمَا
honesty.hadithTranslation: The seller and the buyer have the right to keep or return goods as long as they have not parted. If both parties speak the truth and describe the defects and qualities, they will be blessed in their transaction. If they tell lies or hide something, the blessings of their transaction will be lost.
honesty.point1: Always disclose all product defects and issues
honesty.point2: Provide accurate descriptions and avoid false advertising
honesty.point3: Be transparent about prices, terms, and conditions

riba.title: 2. Prohibition of Riba (Interest/Usury)
riba.quranTranslation: Allah has permitted trade and has forbidden interest.
riba.point2: Do not charge interest on late payments
riba.point3: Use profit-sharing or fixed-price sales instead

gharar.title: 3. Avoid Gharar (Excessive Uncertainty)
gharar.hadithSource: عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
gharar.hadithArabic: نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ عَنْ بَيْعِ الْغَرَرِ
gharar.hadithTranslation: The Messenger of Allah (PBUH) forbade sales involving uncertainty (gharar).
gharar.point1: Do not sell items you do not own or possess
gharar.point2: Avoid vague or uncertain terms in contracts
gharar.point3: Ensure clear delivery terms and product specifications

fairness.title: 4. Fair Pricing and Justice
fairness.quranArabic: وَأَقِيمُوا الْوَزْنَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا الْمِيزَانَ
fairness.quranTranslation: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
fairness.point3: Charge fair prices, especially to those in need

deception.title: 5. Prohibition of Deception
deception.hadithSource: عن أبي هريرة عن النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم
deception.hadithTranslation: He who deceives is not of us.
deception.point1: Never hide defects or issues with products
deception.point2: Do not make false claims about products

haram.title: 6. Avoid Haram Goods and Services
haram.point1: Do not trade in alcohol, pork, or other haram items
haram.point2: Avoid businesses related to gambling, usury, or immorality
haram.point3: Ensure all products are halal and permissible

bribery.title: 7. Prohibition of Bribery
bribery.quranArabic: وَلَا تَأْكُلُوا أَمْوَالَكُم بَيْنَكُم بِالْبَاطِلِ وَتُدْلُوا بِهَا إِلَى الْحُكَّامِ
bribery.quranTranslation: And do not consume one another's wealth unjustly or send it [in bribery] to the rulers...
bribery.point1: Never offer or accept bribes to secure contracts
bribery.point2: Maintain transparency in all business dealings

about.title: About REDA TECH Store Management
about.subtitle: A comprehensive store management solution designed to streamline your business operations with modern technology and intuitive design.

features.servicesDesc: Service appointment scheduling with service types management, due date tracking, overdue/due soon alerts, completion status with confirm dialog, service ticket and service label printing (multiple sizes, WYSIWYG preview), search by service name, type or device, and service history
features.adminDesc: System administration with user management, activity log (audit trail with filters and links to sales/services), backup/restore tools, receipt and printer configuration, update management, system logger, and comprehensive settings
features.notificationsDesc: Real-time alerts for low stock, overdue payments, due soon payments, overdue bills, due soon bills, and overdue services with configurable notification badges
features.reportingDesc: Comprehensive reports with profit analysis, sales trends, best/worst selling products, and business insights
features.sessionsDesc: Support for multiple concurrent cashier sessions with individual tracking and management
features.receiptsDesc: Customizable receipt printing with multilingual support, barcode, store info, and detailed transaction data with category information
features.suppliersDesc: Complete supplier database with purchase tracking, payment history, and relationship management
features.backupDesc: Automated backup system with data export/import and disaster recovery capabilities
features.loggerDesc: Comprehensive logging system for debugging, monitoring, and system maintenance
features.accountsDesc: User account management with role-based permissions and access control
features.zakatDesc: Islamic wealth calculation tool with automatic stock value calculation, Nisab threshold support, 2.5% Zakat calculation, and comprehensive Islamic commerce guidelines with Quran quotes and Hadith references
features.activityLogDesc: Audit trail of user actions: logins, sales, clients, suppliers, services, bills, backups, and settings changes. Filter by user, date range, or search; view sale or service details from log entries; configurable retention and cleanup

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes how REDA TECH Store Management handles information for your shop on this computer. Last updated: May 2026.
privacy.localOperations: Day-to-day shop records (sales, stock, clients, bills, and related data) are stored in a local SQLite database on this PC. Using the app offline does not, by itself, upload that operational data.
privacy.registrationData: During first-time setup, the app may send your full name, phone number, and—when you link an existing shop—your customer ID to REDA TECH's online provisioning service to register this device and start a trial or restore access.
privacy.deviceIdentity: The app uses a device identifier derived from this computer (Windows MachineGuid) for licensing, device linking, and activation checks.
privacy.licensingChecks: When online services are configured, the app contacts REDA TECH servers to verify whether this device may run. Trial and paid licence end dates may be stored locally for a limited offline grace period after a successful check.
privacy.cloudBackup: If you use cloud backup while your device is activated, the app can upload a database backup together with customer and device identifiers and the app version. A new upload replaces the previous cloud copy for that customer. Restore from cloud may be offered during welcome or login when the local database is empty, subject to online configuration.
privacy.accountsAndLogs: Staff usernames and passwords for the app are stored locally. Administrative activity and optional application logs remain on this device unless you export or back them up.
privacy.onlineProviders: Online registration, licensing, and cloud backup rely on configured backend services (including infrastructure such as Supabase) to operate those features—not to build advertising profiles.
privacy.yourChoices: You can create local backups, restore from backup files, and choose when to perform a manual cloud upload. Without internet access, online licensing and cloud backup are limited, but local shop data remains on this PC.
privacy.contact: Questions about this policy may be directed to your authorised supplier or to REDA TECH using the developer contact details shown in this application.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms govern your use of REDA TECH Store Management on this computer. By installing, registering, or using the app, you agree to them.
terms.licenseGrant: Rights to use the software are granted through your supplier's licence (monthly, yearly, or lifetime). The app is intended for lawful retail and store-management use by your business.
terms.trialAccess: A new device may receive a time-limited trial when registered online, as described during setup. After the trial, continued access requires a paid licence activated by your supplier unless otherwise agreed.
terms.offlineGrace: After a successful online licence check, the app may allow limited use while offline for up to seven days when checks cannot reach the server. Once that grace expires or the licence is revoked, online verification is required again.
terms.supplierActivation: Licensing, billing, and activation are handled by your supplier, not inside the app. Access may be suspended if licence records show the device is not allowed.
terms.acceptableUse: You are responsible for accurate business data, compliance with applicable local law (including tax and accounting rules), and securing staff accounts on your premises.
terms.warranty: The software is provided as is and as available, without warranties of uninterrupted operation, error-free performance, or fitness for a particular purpose.
terms.liability: To the maximum extent permitted by law, REDA TECH is not liable for loss of data, lost profits, or indirect damages. You are responsible for maintaining backups of business-critical data.
terms.updates: Updates and support may be delivered when available through the app's update mechanisms and your supplier.
terms.termination: Licences may end, change, or transfer according to supplier terms. If access ends, you may retain local data files subject to your backups and export rights.
terms.changes: We may update these terms and the privacy policy; material changes will be reflected in a future app release. Continued use after updates constitutes acceptance.
terms.governingLaw: These terms are intended for users in Algeria and shall be interpreted in accordance with applicable Algerian law, without prejudice to mandatory consumer protections.

admin.backup.title: Database Backup Management
admin.backup.description: Manage your database backups. The system automatically creates daily backups and keeps the 2 most recent ones.
admin.backup.descriptionPage: Backups are grouped below: automatic (daily on this PC), cloud (snapshot + upload), and manual (local copies you create). Use Refresh to reload lists.
admin.backup.sectionAutoDesc: Created daily when you use the app; only the two most recent files are kept in the backup folder.
admin.backup.sectionCloudDesc: Creates a cloud_backup file on this PC, uploads it to your supplier's online storage, and lists snapshots here.
admin.backup.sectionManualDesc: Local copies you create in the backup folder, or save elsewhere with "Backup to custom path" (those paths are not listed here).
admin.backup.emptyAuto: No automatic backups yet. They appear after daily backup runs.
admin.backup.emptyCloud: Nothing downloaded from the cloud yet. Use “Download from cloud” above, then you can restore this single file like any other backup.
admin.backup.emptyManual: No manual backups in the folder yet. Create one with the buttons above.
admin.backup.automaticBackupDesc: The system automatically creates a backup every day at startup and keeps the 2 most recent backups. You can create manual backups on this PC anytime, or use Cloud backup to save a separate snapshot and upload it (not the same as manual).
admin.backup.noBackupsAvailable: No backups available. Create your first backup to get started.
admin.backup.cloudSectionDesc: Creates a temporary snapshot on this PC, uploads it to your supplier’s online storage, then removes that local copy after a successful send. Manual backups stay on this computer only unless you copy them yourself.
admin.backup.deleteBackupDesc: This permanently removes the file from your backup folder. This cannot be undone.
admin.backup.warningDesc: Restoring a backup will completely replace your current database. Make sure to create a manual backup before restoring if you want to keep your current data.
